metadata.title: Integral curvature estimates and geodesic limits for stable abelian Higgs fields
metadata.abstract: We prove that, on closed three-manifolds, the limit interface of a sequence of stable abelian Higgs critical points with uniformly bounded energy is a finite union of smooth closed immersed geodesics, possibly with multiplicity and self-intersections. This follows from an integral estimate for the diffuse curvature, derived from an integral bound on the discrepancy.
metadata.comment: 28 pages. This proof was generated by ChatGPT Astra 6 via a series of interactions with the authors. The authors reworked, checked and rewrote the proof. All comments are welcome

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 作者从局部稳定性得到差异量及弥散曲率积分控制，通过局部化且保持无散的 Jacobian 向量场，将转向估计传到极限图；任意奇方向测试函数迫使各分支与相反方向按重数配对，从而拼成光滑测地线。闭三维流形上极限可带重数和自交。
analysis.breakthrough: 用误差量的积分界控制弥散曲率，进而刻画稳定极限界面。
analysis.limitations: 已读 PDF 第 1–5 页主定理及证明路线，尚未逐条核验稳定性计算与极限步骤；结论不排除自交，也不要求重数为一。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Astra-6 在作者提出研究方向后、较少协助下产生初始证明；作者随后检查和重写以突出数学思想、改善表述。
